subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Deepfakes and Synthetic Media
description: A quick, practical guide to Deepfakes and Synthetic Media.

hook.text: A video shows a world leader saying something shocking. It looks real. It sounds real. It's completely fake.

buildup.text: Deepfakes use AI to create hyper-realistic fake videos of real people saying or doing things that never happened.

discovery.text: The technology is now so accessible that anyone with a laptop can create a convincing deepfake in hours.

twist.text: Deepfakes erode trust in all video evidence. If anything can be faked, nothing can be believed.

climax.text: Social media spreads deepfakes faster than fact-checkers can debunk them. Seeing is no longer believing.

punchline.text: Looks real. Sounds real. Completely fabricated.

quiz.question: What is the broader societal threat of deepfake technology?
options: It erodes trust in all video and audio evidence
Deepfakes are easy for everyone to detect
